assumptions.statement: All hazardous materials and active devices are represented by qualified closed services.
Robots handle supported safe-to-exchange carriers only; trajectories and grasp forces remain unimplemented.
Branch divisions and prerequisite DAG are an auditable reconstruction, not historical lab chronology.
Pipe shape response is in scope; unqualified fluid delivery is not.
Reported source conditions do not fill absent device safety parameters or allow a generic post-cure.
